Name: CP - SH's Little Duckies - Duck Replacers
Author: plurffle
Description:
Just wanted the coop duck sprites to match the ducks from my other mods ⋋(•⌔•)⋌ ♡

This mod replaces the sprites of the adult ducks which come with three color options (the vanilla green, brown, and white) as well as the duck feather item which also comes with three color options (blue, brown, and white, but this specific replacement can also be disabled!). Everything is configurable!

Currently, the default duck is the green version and the default duck feather color is blue, but you can definitely choose whichever you want in your game!


[img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img]

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]How to install this mod?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]Unzip the zip file and place the "[CP] SH's Little Duckies - Duck Replacers" folder in your Mods folder.

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is this mod compatible with mobile/multiplayer?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]I do not have the mobile version of the game, but I assume it should be work just fine in there since this is a Content Patcher mod. This should definitely work in multiplayer!

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is there going to be an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version of this mod?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]You can get that here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44256]AT - SH's Little Duckies - Duck Replacers[/url]



I have a Ko-fi btw! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
